project.title: Quantum-Inspired Optimization for Deadlock-Aware Process & Resource Scheduling
project.subtitle: Phase 1 — Algorithmic Benchmark on Generated Data

parameters.name: QEA Population Size
parameters.rationale: Small enough for fast runs; large enough for diversity

parameters.name: Max Iterations
parameters.rationale: Upper bound; early-stop via convergence limit

parameters.name: Convergence Limit
parameters.rationale: Stop if no improvement for 20 consecutive generations

parameters.name: Initial Qubit Angle θ
parameters.rationale: Equal superposition: α² = β² = 0.5, no initial bias

parameters.name: Rotation Step Δθ
parameters.rationale: ~9° per update; balances convergence speed vs exploration

parameters.name: Fitness Weight: Deadlock
parameters.rationale: Dominant term — deadlock is always worse than any schedule

parameters.name: Fitness Weight: Unfinished
parameters.rationale: Secondary — each incomplete process is penalised

parameters.name: Fitness Weight: ResourceWaste
parameters.rationale: Tertiary — idle resource instances at end

parameters.name: Banker Repetitions
parameters.rationale: Deterministic — repeated only for timing statistics

parameters.name: QEA / Hybrid Repetitions
parameters.rationale: Stochastic — 30 runs gives reliable mean and std dev
